finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If m_name contains a semicolon or other shell metacharacters, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The code is running in an environment where the file name is interpreted by a shell, such as a script or a command line.

parsed.refutation_attempt: The code does not involve any shell command execution. The file name is constructed using string operations and then passed to the `open` method of `std::ofstream`, which does not involve a shell. Therefore, there is no risk of OS command injection.
